names.note: The nominative the calendar's own name page gives, «Иоанн (Румянцев), иерей, сщмч.», with the rank words dropped; the day line gives the forename alone in the genitive with «пресвитера» and no surname. Read 13 October 2026.

death.note: The calendar's day line closes «(после 1937)» — after 1937 — for the four of them together, so the interval has no upper bound and the year is a lower one rather than a year of death. No year of birth and no age is given. Read 13 October 2026.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 июля ст. ст. — «Cщмч. Иоанна пресвитера, св. Константина исп., пресвитера, мц. Анны и св. Елисаветы исп (после 1937).» The line's first word is printed with a Latin C (U+0043) in place of the Cyrillic С, and is quoted here as the page has it.
